description: Round 2 of the full-parity phase (expressions family, seeds 7001-7005, 10000 cases): the one new mismatch cluster, minimised, with oracle probes of its variants. The operand kind of `*`, `b-and`, `b-or` and `b-xor`, and P3's string cast of a constant array operand of `~`, inside PHP array literals, where zend_try_ct_eval_array() folds conditionals with a constant test. Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical.

vectors.note: minimised from x7002-01328-arith: dump()'s arguments are compiled as `...[...]`, an array literal

case.data_php: $__fuzz_data = (static function () use ($twig) { $__fuzz_data = (static function () use ($twig) { if (!class_exists('TwigTestStringy', false)) { class TwigTestStringy implements \Stringable { public function __construct(private string $v) {} public function __toString(): string { return $this->v; } } } return ['yes' => true, 'str7' => new TwigTestStringy('7')]; })(); unset($__fuzz_data['yes']); return $__fuzz_data;; })(); unset($__fuzz_data['yes']); return $__fuzz_data;
